intro: Wallace Downtown is Wallace Real Estate's office in the heart of downtown Knoxville, on South Gay Street near Market Square and the Old City. Led by principal broker Jennifer Montgomery, our agents help buyers and sellers in downtown Knoxville, the historic in-town neighborhoods and communities across Knox County, backed by the full marketing, data and relocation resources of Wallace Real Estate.
visit: Our office is on South Gay Street in downtown Knoxville, steps from Market Square, the Tennessee Theatre and the riverfront. Stop in, call or send us a message.
footer_blurb: Wallace Real Estate's downtown Knoxville office, serving buyers and sellers in the urban core, the historic in-town neighborhoods and communities across Knox County.
stories: Living downtown means walking to dinner on Market Square, a show at the Tennessee Theatre or the Bijou, Saturday farmers markets and a stroll along the river. Lofts and condos put you in the middle of it, with less yard work and more time to enjoy the city.

Knoxville's in-town neighborhoods, like Fourth & Gill, Old North, Happy Holler and Fort Sanders, are full of restored Victorian and craftsman homes. Neighbors know each other, porches get used, and downtown is only a few minutes away.

Downtown is our home base, but Knox County has room for every stage of life. When it is time for a bigger yard, a lake or a few acres, we help you find it in South Knoxville, Fountain City, Hardin Valley, Powell or the counties nearby.
